sources.role: directory layout, config sections, save/state naming, PIF/64DD settings (VERSION v0.9.0)
platform support: Windows releases; Linux AppImage/Flathub/AUR/COPR; no macOS

paths.path: ~/.config/RMG/mupen64plus.cfg (or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/RMG/): RMG passes CoreGetUserConfigDirectory() as the mupen64plus ConfigDirOverride, and stores ALL of its own GUI settings through the core's config API, so one INI holds the [Core] section plus RMG sections 'Rosalie's Mupen GUI', 'Rosalie's Mupen GUI Core' (+ Overlay/Settings/64DD/PIF/Gameboy sub-sections), 'Rosalie's Mupen GUI KeyBindings', 'Rosalie's Mupen GUI RomBrowser', and plugin sections. Controller configuration is RMG's own input plugin (RMG-Input, SDL3): per-port profiles are config sections 'Rosalie's Mupen GUI - Input Plugin Profile <1..4>' (SDL3 keyboard/gamepad bindings, pak, rumble packs, deadzone), shared named profiles are sections 'Rosalie's Mupen GUI - Input Plugin User Profile "<name>"', and per-game overrides live in a section named after the ROM's internal name (UseGameProfile key); a bundled SDL_GameControllerDB gamecontrollerdb.txt is loaded from the shared-data directory at plugin start
evidence: source:RMG-Core/Core.cpp CoreInit: m64p::Core.Startup(config dir = CoreGetUserConfigDirectory(), shared dir = CoreGetSharedDataDirectory()) and config_override_user_dirs -> Config.OverrideUserPaths(data, cache) @3e8b366be

source:RMG-Input/main.cpp userProfileSectionBase 'Rosalie's Mupen GUI - Input Plugin User Profile', section 'Rosalie's Mupen GUI - Input Plugin Profile <i>', per-game section UseGameProfile @3e8b366be
source:RMG-Input/main.cpp sdl_init loads SDL_GameControllerDB/gamecontrollerdb.txt from the shared data directory @3e8b366be

paths.path: ~/.local/share/RMG/Save/Game (or $XDG_DATA_HOME/RMG/Save/Game): RMG force-writes the core [Core] SaveSRAMPath key (ForceUseSetAlways) to CoreGetDefaultSaveDirectory() = user data dir + 'Save/Game'
paths.naming: mupen64plus core naming: <save filename>.eep | .sra | .fla | .mpk for EEPROM/SRAM/FlashRAM/Controller-Pak. Default SaveFilenameFormat=1 yields '<goodname (max 32 chars)>-<first 8 hex of ROM MD5>'; a legacy <goodname>.<ext> file is still used when present; format 0 uses the raw ROM header name. Game Boy (Transfer Pak) RAM is <gbrom>.<player#>.sav
evidence: source:RMG-Core/Directories.cpp CoreGetDefaultSaveDirectory = CoreGetUserDataDirectory()/Save/Game; data dir = $XDG_DATA_HOME/RMG or $HOME/.local/share/RMG @3e8b366be
source:3rdParty/mupen64plus-core/src/main/main.c get_save_filename goodname32-MD5[0:8]; *.mpk/*.eep/*.sra/*.fla with legacy fallback; gb '%s%s.%u.sav' @3e8b366be

paths.path: ~/.local/share/RMG/Save/State: the [Core] SaveStatePath key is force-set to CoreGetDefaultSaveStateDirectory() = user data dir + 'Save/State'
paths.naming: <goodname (max 32)>-<MD5[0:8]>.st<slot> with slots 0..9 (CoreGetSaveStatePath builds .st<slot>; keeps a legacy <goodname>.st<slot> file if it exists; filename characters :<>"/\|?* are sanitized to '_'); format 0 uses the ROM header name instead of goodname-MD5
evidence: source:RMG-Core/SaveState.cpp CoreGetSaveStatePath: .st<slot> extension, legacy goodname path reuse, SaveFileNameFormat branch, char sanitization @3e8b366be
source:RMG-Core/SaveState.cpp CoreIncrease/DecreaseSaveStateSlot clamp slot >= 0 (0..9 range with the GUI slot counter) @3e8b366be

paths.path: None required. PIF/CIC are emulated by default: the optional user PIF ROMs are configured in section 'Rosalie's Mupen GUI Core PIF' (PIF_Use=false by default, PIF_NTSC / PIF_PAL file paths; skipped when the dynarec CPU emulator is selected, and MD5-validated by the core before use). 64DD discs additionally need IPL ROM paths in 'Rosalie's Mupen GUI Core 64DD' (64DD_JapaneseIPL / 64DD_AmericanIPL / 64DD_DevelopmentIPL, blank by default)
evidence: source:RMG-Core/Emulation.cpp open_pif_rom: only when PIF_Use is set and the file exists; M64CMD_PIF_OPEN; skipped when cpuEmulator >= 2 (dynarec) @3e8b366be
source:3rdParty/mupen64plus-core/src/main/main.c open_pif MD5-whitelists old/new NTSC and PAL PIF ROMs @3e8b366be
db:firmware_rules has no N64 rows (gap: an optional manual rule for 64DD IPL is the only candidate; cart games need no firmware)

linux.notes: Flatpak com.github.Rosalie241.RMG relocates the same tree under ~/.var/app/com.github.Rosalie241.RMG/{config,data,cache}/RMG. Lunchbox launches with a private data root; native saves/states stay in Save/Game and Save/State unless a portable install is used.

paths.path: %APPDATA%\RMG\Config\mupen64plus.cfg (SHGetSpecialFolderLocation CSIDL_APPDATA + '\RMG\Config'; falls back to the executable directory when AppData cannot be resolved). Portable installs (portable.txt or a Config\mupen64plus.cfg beside the exe) keep everything in the install directory instead. Same single-INI section layout and RMG-Input controller sections as Linux
evidence: source:RMG-Core/Directories.cpp get_appdata_directory (CSIDL_APPDATA + '/RMG/' + dir) and CoreGetPortableDirectoryMode (portable.txt or Config/mupen64plus.cfg next to exe) @3e8b366be
source:RMG-Core/Settings.cpp + RMG-Input/main.cpp section definitions as on Linux @3e8b366be

paths.path: %APPDATA%\RMG\Save\Game (the Windows getter appends 'Save/Game' to the AppData root directly); portable installs: <install dir>\Save\Game
paths.naming: <goodname (max 32)>-<MD5[0:8]>.eep | .sra | .fla | .mpk (SaveFilenameFormat=1 default, legacy <goodname>.<ext> fallback); Game Boy RAM <gbrom>.<player#>.sav
evidence: source:RMG-Core/Settings.cpp SaveSRAMPath force-set to the default save directory @3e8b366be

paths.naming: <goodname (max 32)>-<MD5[0:8]>.st<slot>, slots 0..9, legacy <goodname>.st<slot> reuse and filename sanitization as on Linux

paths.path: None required; optional PIF ROM paths (PIF_NTSC/PIF_PAL) and 64DD IPL paths (64DD_JapaneseIPL/64DD_AmericanIPL/64DD_DevelopmentIPL) live in the same mupen64plus.cfg sections as on Linux

windows.notes: Upstream ships an installer and portable zip for Windows; RMG has no macOS build (README lists Windows and Linux only), so no macos platform is captured. The Lunchbox DB Gopher64/RMG rows also miss macOS for Gopher64 (RMG correctly Windows;Linux).
